about: Pages added by hand to docs/scoreboard-tools.md, beside the pinned corpora (bench/PREREG.md). Each is a Wayback Machine capture, pinned by the SHA-256 of its bytes, fetched into bench/cache/ and never committed. Labels written by hand from the page a reader sees, on 2026-09-26, before any tool was run on it.

pages.why: The page that prompted the comparison: a blog post built with Framer, which declares no author or date in markup, shows its date above the title and its author in a byline under it, and writes the time the site was last built in an HTML comment (<!-- Published Sep 22, 2026, 4:54 AM UTC --> in this capture).

with: Models have been superhuman at chat for years, so where is all the automation?
